summary: A structural site footer with brand, link columns, socials, and legal copy.
purpose: Close a marketing surface with navigation and legal lines. It carries no product content of its own; brand, links, and copy are passed in, so the design system stays content-free.

anatomy.description: Brand name, optional tagline, and social icon buttons.
Copyright, optional address, and a closing note or disclaimer.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns of navigation links, each { title, links }.

props.name: socials
props.description: Social links, each { label, icon, href }; icons supplied by the consumer.

props.name: address
props.description: A single line of address or location text.

whenToUse: Closing a marketing or landing surface with navigation and legal copy.
Any page that needs brand, sitemap links, and socials in one block.

whenNotToUse.scenario: A dense in-app dashboard with no marketing chrome

do: Supply your own brand, links, and legal copy as props.
Give every social link a descriptive label for its aria-label.
dont: Expect product copy baked in; the component ships content-free.
Hardcode link colors; they come from tokens.

content.voice: Marketing voice for links and tagline; plain and factual for legal lines.
rules: Disclaimers stay literal, no jokes that read as legal claims.

tokensUsed.usage: Top borders and social button borders.
Hover color for links and socials.

keyboard: All links and social buttons are reachable in DOM order.
aria: Each social icon button carries an aria-label from its label.
accessibility.contrast: Link and legal text hold at least 4.5:1 against the canvas.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus on links and social buttons.

examples.title: Full footer
examples.code: <Footer brand="UnmessMe" tagline="therapy-parody for your hot mess" columns={cols} socials={socials} copyright="© 2025 UnmessMe Inc." />

related.whenToChoose: AppShell is the page frame and header; Footer is the closing block inside it.
